## Goal

Acquire source data and preserve it in `input/raw` without modification.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)

raw_dir <- here("input", "raw")
processed_dir <- here("input", "processed")
output_dir <- here("output")
```

## Import

### CSV

```{r}
df <- readr::read_csv(file.path(raw_dir, "population_communes_2024.csv"))
```

### Excel

```{r}
readxl::excel_sheets(file.path(raw_dir, "source_workbook.xlsx"))

df <- readxl::read_excel(
  file.path(raw_dir, "source_workbook.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Data"
)
```

### JSON

Load `jsonlite` only when the project needs JSON.

```{r}
df <- jsonlite::fromJSON(
  file.path(raw_dir, "api_response.json"),
  simplifyDataFrame = TRUE
)
```

Record the source URL, acquisition date and any manual selection made before downloading.
